optionalMods.description: Removes useless information from the debug screen.

optionalMods.name: LambDynamicLights
optionalMods.description: The most feature-complete dynamic lighting mod.

optionalMods.name: Pick Up Notifier
optionalMods.description: Be notified about all the things you

optionalMods.name: Screenshot to Clipboard
optionalMods.description: Any time you take a screenshot in the game, the image data is copied to the clipboard. You can then paste this anywhere (e.g. Discord) to upload the image and share it with others.

optionalMods.name: Screenshot Viewer
optionalMods.description: A mod that allows you to see and manage (through right-clicking) your screenshots in game!

optionalMods.name: Advancement Plaques
optionalMods.description: Replaces standard advancement toasts with fancy plaques.

optionalMods.name: AppleSkin
optionalMods.description: Adds various food-related HUD improvements

optionalMods.name: Chat Heads
optionalMods.description:
See who are you chatting with!
This mod adds player heads next to their chat messages.

optionalMods.name: ChatAnimation
optionalMods.description: Adds animations to the chat.

optionalMods.name: Obscure Tooltips
optionalMods.description: Stylized tooltips with beautiful effects and smooth animations!

optionalMods.name: Scribble
optionalMods.description: Expertly edit your books with rich formatting options, page utilities and more!

optionalMods.name: Immersive Hotbar
optionalMods.description: Adds animations to the hotbar that make it more immersive.

optionalMods.name: Yeetus Experimentus
optionalMods.description: Disables the Experimental Settings popup, which appears when you create or load world.

optionalMods.name: Xaero
optionalMods.description: A self-writing fullscreen map which also works as an add-on to Xaero's Minimap.

optionalMods.name: Better Ping Display
optionalMods.description: Shows the actual ping number instead of just bars in the player list.

optionalMods.name: WaveyCapes
optionalMods.description: The cape shouldn't be a static slab!

optionalMods.name: Longer Chat History
optionalMods.description: Makes the game keep more messages in your chat history.

optionalMods.name: Cubes Without Borders
optionalMods.description: Allows you to play Minecraft in a borderless fullscreen window.

optionalMods.name: ClientSort
optionalMods.description: Versatile and easy inventory sorting.

optionalMods.name: Cinematic Respawn
optionalMods.description: Cinematic respawn experience for Minecraft.

optionalMods.name: Sodium Shadowy Path Blocks
optionalMods.description: SSPB reintroduces vanilla-like smooth lighting to non-full blocks (e.g. dirt paths and how they have dark shading when directly next to a full block) when using Sodium.

optionalMods.name: Perception
optionalMods.description: Enriching the world with immersive visual effects

optionalMods.name: Create: Blueprinted
optionalMods.description: Render Create Mod schematics to a PNG image with a single click.

optionalMods.name: ImmersiveUI
optionalMods.description: Makes your UI flashy :D

optionalMods.name: Dark Loading Screen
optionalMods.description: Darkens and customizes the Minecraft loading screen.

optionalMods.name: Distant Horizons
optionalMods.description: This mod generates and renders simplified terrain beyond the normal view distance at a low performance cost. Allowing you to see much farther without turning your game into a slideshow.

optionalMods.name: Presence Footsteps (NeoForge)
optionalMods.description: An overly complicated sound mod

optionalMods.name: Presence Footsteps x Sable
optionalMods.description: Presence Footsteps compatability for Sable

optionalMods.name: Iris
optionalMods.description: Iris is a modern shaders mod for Minecraft intended to be compatible with existing OptiFine shader packs.

optionalMods.name: Colorwheel
optionalMods.description: Allows you to use Iris Shaders with Flywheel

optionalMods.name: Colorwheel Patcher
optionalMods.description: Autopatch supported shaders to be compatible with Colorwheel

optionalMods.name: Sound Physics Remastered
optionalMods.description: Provides realistic sound attenuation, reverberation, and absorption through blocks.

optionalMods.name: Entity Model Features
optionalMods.description:
This is an expansion of the ETF mod, it adds support for OptiFine format Custom Entity Model (CEM) resource packs.
While still allowing to you disable this to use a different model mod :)

optionalMods.name: Entity Texture Features
optionalMods.description:
Adds support for resource-pack driven features for entity textures including some OptiFine features
Supports OptiFine:
 - Random & Custom textures
 - Emissive textures
With more features such as:
 - Blinking textures
 - Player Skin support

optionalMods.name: Constant Music
optionalMods.description: Control the silence between music.

optionalMods.name: Aeronautics Wind Sound
optionalMods.description:
A mod that allows you to hear the sound of wind while riding an Aeronautics vehicle, with the volume dynamically adjusted based on the vehicle's speed and whether you are sheltered.
You can adjust the speed threshold, volume range, and sheltered volume coefficient in the config file.
一个能在你乘坐航空学载具时令你听到破风声的模组，根据载具速度和是否遮蔽会调节响度
在配置文件里可以调节速度阈值、响度范围、遮蔽时响度系数

optionalMods.name: Just Zoom
optionalMods.description: Zoom by pressing a hotkey and adjust the zoom factor with your mouse wheel!

optionalMods.name: AmbientSounds
optionalMods.description: Expands minecraft's ambient sounds.

description.ru: Полный комфортный набор без тяжёлых опциональных эффектов и AmbientSounds.
description.en: A complete comfortable setup without the heaviest optional effects or AmbientSounds.

description.ru: Только полезные клиентские улучшения для максимальной производительности.
description.en: Only useful client improvements for the best performance.

description.ru: Всё, что есть в сборке: визуальные эффекты, звук и шейдеры.
description.en: Everything in the pack: visual effects, sound, and shaders.

description.ru: Включает Iris, Colorwheel и Colorwheel Patcher. После включения выберите шейдерпак в настройках видео Minecraft.
description.en: Enables Iris, Colorwheel, and Colorwheel Patcher. Then choose a shader pack in Minecraft video settings.
